up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614234. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, exact standard value, standard units, and canonical SMILES. Filter to include only exact activity measurements where standard_relation equals '=' and standard_value is not null. Do not apply any additional filters or row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614234' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
